# Architecture decisions

Important technical decisions are recorded as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs): one short file per
decision, named `ADR-0001-short-title.md`, created from `_template-adr.md`. Records are never deleted; a
decision that changes gets a new ADR that supersedes the old one.

Write an ADR when a choice is hard to reverse, affects several modules, adds a dependency, or when people are
likely to ask "why did we do it this way?".
